text:
Digital library apps are wonderful for convenience, but they aren't infallible. Between server timeouts, expired licenses, and frustrating login loops, the technology can occasionally fail right when you're settling in to read.

That’s why having a manual fallback is essential. Keeping a physical copy on your shelf or a downloaded PDF on a local device ensures your reading momentum isn't broken by a glitchy interface. Technology should enhance our access to books, not become a barrier to them.
